root_cause.text: The `rt_mt6_check` function lacked a bounds check ensuring `rtinfo->addrnr` did not exceed `IP6T_RT_HOPS`, allowing malformed rules to pass validation and cause out-of-bounds access in `rt_mt6`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `if (rtinfo->addrnr > IP6T_RT_HOPS) { ... return -EINVAL; }` in `rt_mt6_check`, while the CVE description notes `rt_mt6()` expects `addrnr` to stay within the bounds of `rtinfo->addrs[]`.
